example.title: The Seabird Ocean Resort (2020), Mission Avenue at Pacific Street

brief: A 2020 resort hotel one block from the pier: a six-storey block of grey and white shingle-style siding with white-railed balconies on every bay, gabled and flat roof sections, a stair tower lettered with its name, restaurant terraces and palms at street level. One photo (2022). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
